stories.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
stories.brief: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

stories.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
stories.brief: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

stories.title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways
stories.brief: Musk's announcement comes after Anthropic pledged to create a public benefit fund ahead of its blockbuster stock market listing.

stories.title: Don't fall for this - how to protect yourself from AI scams
stories.brief: Trading standards officers say AI is "super-charging" existing scams through clones and fake websites.

stories.title: PM asks FBR to plug tax gap amid pruning plans
stories.brief: The federal government on Monday dropped the idea of setting up a new tax agency but decided to compulsorily retire non-performing officers by amending the Civil Servants Act, which would allow it to retrench bureaucrats as part of any restructuring.

stories.title: Russia offers a diplomatic off-ramp in Pak-Afghan standoff
stories.brief: Russia on Monday offered to help defuse tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan, signaling a potentially greater diplomatic role for Moscow at a time when relations between Islamabad and Kabul have deteriorated sharply over the issue of cross-border terrorism.

stories.title: Twin cities brace for smog
stories.brief: The smog season has begun and will continue until January 15, with the air quality index deteriorating across the twin cities of Rawalpindi and Islamabad and other parts of Punjab, raising concerns about the spread of diseases.

stories.title: Achakzai seeks K-P CM whereabouts
stories.brief: National Assembly Opposition Leader Mahmood Khan Achakzai on Monday questioned the non-issuance of production orders for detained lawmakers and the whereabouts of Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi following the imposition of emergency in the province.

stories.title: Senate passes bill to restrict blue passports
stories.brief: The Senate approved the Passport Amendment Bill 2026, moved by Senator Abdul Qadir, after an extended debate over the eligibility criteria for blue passports and the treatment of parliamentarians by government departments.

stories.title: Northern Ireland needs 'courage and leadership' to tackle climate change
stories.brief: The new chair of the Climate Change Committee is spending two days in Northern Ireland on a fact-finding mission.

stories.title: How is the US economy really doing under President Trump?
stories.brief: Ahead of the midterms Trump has boasted about the performance of the US economy. BBC Verify looks at inflation, jobs and economic growth in the country.

stories.title: ‘These risks are real’: the threat of AI bioweapons – podcast
stories.brief: In his annual speech on threats to the nation, Sir Ken McCallum, the head of the UK’s intelligence service, MI5, warned that AI had the potential to ‘change the stakes’ on existing and even new bioweapons.

stories.brief: The BBC hears from people who think dating events are better value for money than dating apps.
